function.name: population_projections
function.description: Calculates the projected population growth based on the current growth rate. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

country.description: The country for which to calculate the population projection.

years.description: Number of years for the projection.

growth_rate.description: Optional parameter to specify the growth rate, in percentage. Default is 1.2. This is a float type value.
